topic: Why is Lionel Messi called the greatest of all time?

sentences.text: Why is Lionel Messi called the greatest of all time?
sentences.editorial: question or conclusion drawn from the beats above, not a new claim

sentences.text: Start with the trophies: eight Ballons d'Or.
Then the goals: four hundred and seventy-four in La Liga, a record.
In sampled matches, his key passes more than doubled.
That is the case for the greatest.
